name: Smiling Mascots
storyline:
Welcome to Smiling Mascots, the world's leading creator of cheerful and unforgettable mascots. When the company's founder mysteriously disappears, Sofia sets out to uncover the truth.

What begins as a simple investigation quickly turns into a nightmare. Abandoned locations, statues that seem to move on their own, a bizarre cult, and smiling faces that watch her every move await her at every turn.

Explore six unique locations and uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of the founder of Smiling Mascots.
summary: Smiling Mascots is the leading company in creating cheerful and unforgettable mascots. Take control of Sofia as she investigates the mysterious disappearance of the company's founder and discovers that some smiles are far more disturbing than they appear.
